leaves.name: sga1_XII_3_1_Etale
leaves.doc: sga1-etale: SGA 1 XII 3.1, etale clause, with the analytic space of XII 1.1: for X locally of finite type over C, U affine open and f_1..f_n in Gamma(U) with C[x_1..x_n] -> Gamma(U) etale, Q -> (f_i(Q)) is a homeomorphism from an open neighbourhood of each P in U(C) (analytic topology) onto an open of C^n, and every regular function on U is near P a holomorphic function of the f_i (printed form, special case U affine; locators UNVERIFIED)
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf, no reading recorded; locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: SGA 1 (Grothendieck, LNM 224, 1971), Exp. XII, 1.1 (construction of X^an) and Prop. 3.1 (f etale iff f^an etale, i.e. a local isomorphism of analytic spaces) (locators UNVERIFIED)
